cohort: 200 pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia or gestational hypertension.
finding: An MCA/UA PI ratio ≤1 is a significant predictor of increased maternal (progression to severe preeclampsia/eclampsia, severe oligohydramnios) and neonatal (low birth weight, low Apgar scores, NICU admissions) adverse outcomes in women with preeclampsia or gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: An MCA/UA PI ratio ≤1 was associated with higher rates of emergency cesarean sections.
